headline: CHW @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 4.70 at BAL 4.47, with a projected total of 9.17. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHW: CHW moved +0.71 runs while BAL moved -0.47, changing the projected margin by +1.18 runs. NRFI probability dropped -6.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Erick Fedde has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Miguel Vargas, Sam Antonacci, Pete Alonso, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Colson Montgomery, Coby Mayo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
